about.title: About Deep Electro Services
about.shortTitle: Powering the Future with Reliable Electrical & EV Charging Solutions
about.shortDescription: With over 30 years of electrical industry experience, Deep Electro Services provides reliable EV charging infrastructure, battery testing solutions and technical consultation. As an Authorized Channel Partner of EViGO Charge, we bring the Bijlify range of AC and DC EV Chargers to residential, commercial, industrial and highway charging applications. From product selection and site assessment to technical guidance and installation coordination, we help customers make informed decisions and build reliable, commercially sustainable EV charging infrastructure.
about.commitment: Technical Expertise. Trusted Products. Transparent Guidance. Long-Term Support.
about.description: Deep Electro Services is a Mumbai-based electrical solutions and EV charging infrastructure company committed to delivering reliable, innovative and customer-focused solutions for India's growing electric mobility sector.

longSections.title: About Deep Electro Services
longSections.body: Deep Electro Services is a Mumbai-based electrical solutions and EV charging infrastructure company committed to delivering reliable, innovative and customer-focused solutions for India's growing electric mobility sector. Founded by Mr. Padmakar Sakare, with over 30 years of experience in the electrical industry, Deep Electro Services brings together strong technical knowledge, practical industry experience and a customer-first approach.

longSections.title: Our Expertise
longSections.body: We specialize in EV charging infrastructure and battery testing solutions. We support customers from initial consultation and product selection to technical guidance, installation coordination and after-sales support.

longSections.title: Our EV Charging Solutions
longSections.body: We are an Authorized Channel Partner of EViGO Charge, promoting the Bijlify range of AC and DC EV Chargers, manufactured by Marin Electricals, Goa.
items: AC EV Chargers: 3.3 kW, 7.4 kW, 11 kW, 15 kW and 22 kW.
DC Fast Chargers: 30 kW, 60 kW, 120 kW and 240 kW.
Smart charging solutions with OCPP compatibility, QR payments, UPI, mobile app and cloud-based monitoring.

longSections.title: Who We Serve
longSections.body: We provide EV charging solutions for a wide range of locations and business applications.
items: Residential Societies and Housing Complexes
Real Estate Developers and Commercial Buildings
Hotels, Resorts and Restaurants
Highway Dhabas and Fuel Stations
EV Charging Station Investors and Charge Point Operators (CPOs)
Logistics Parks, Warehouses and Fleet Operators
Electric Bus, Truck and Commercial Vehicle Operators

longSections.title: Our Approach
longSections.body: At Deep Electro Services, we believe that successful EV charging infrastructure requires more than just supplying a charger. It requires the right technical solution, proper electrical infrastructure, suitable location planning and a commercially viable business model. We focus on understanding each customer's requirements and recommending suitable products based on power availability, vehicle compatibility, site conditions and investment capacity. We believe in transparent communication, practical ROI guidance and long-term customer relationships rather than unrealistic business commitments.

longSections.title: Our Vision
longSections.body: To contribute to India's electric mobility revolution by making reliable, accessible and commercially sustainable EV charging infrastructure available across residential, commercial and highway locations.

longSections.title: Our Mission
longSections.body: To deliver dependable electrical and EV charging solutions through technical expertise, quality products, professional service and long-term customer support.

faqs.question: Will every EV charge at the charger's full rated power?
faqs.answer: No. For AC charging, the vehicle's onboard charger limits the AC charging rate. For DC charging, the vehicle's supported DC charging curve, battery condition and charger configuration determine the actual rate.

faqs.question: What electrical load is required?
faqs.answer: It depends on the charger model and site conditions. The application guide includes preliminary planning estimates only. Confirm input current, protection, cable sizing, earthing and sanctioned load against the manufacturer's datasheet and a qualified electrical design.

faqs.question: Can a dual-gun charger charge two vehicles together?
faqs.answer: Some dual-gun models support simultaneous charging with power sharing. The available output per vehicle depends on the exact model and configuration; check the relevant datasheet.

faqs.question: What support services are available for Bijlify EV chargers?
faqs.answer: Deep Electro Services can coordinate product guidance, technical support, charger performance follow-up and software-related support. The applicable scope and terms are confirmed in the service agreement.
